description.value: The Hub is a community gathering restaurant and entertainment venue in Scotch Creek on Shuswap Lake, hosting live music, comedy shows, dinner theatre, and seasonal events. The kitchen turns out a broad menu including house-smoked brisket, hand-crafted beverages, and a plant-based burger option, with indoor and outdoor spaces suited to the lakeside setting. A shuttle service is available for patrons needing a safe ride to and from the venue.
